subject: Throughput shortfall impacting month-end: Clearwater Analytics — request for emergency burst & remediation
messages:
From: James Howell <j.howell@clearwater-analytics.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@clearwater-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent — month-end job failures (500s) and surge in latency

Vanessa / Redwood team,

We're seeing a material degradation during our month-end reconciliation window. Starting ~07:50 PDT we began to see high latencies (p95 spiking from ~120ms to >2.3s) and a rising number of 5xx responses from the Redwood endpoint tied to our reserved capacity. Several jobs failed and retried which made the spike worse.

Impact:
- Multiple reconciliation jobs timed out and delayed downstream reporting
- Errors reference request ids in attached clearwater-job-ids.txt and screenshot attached for the ops dashboard
- This is blocking our finance close tonight — we need a rapid mitigation plan and confirmation of what authority you have to temporarily increase throughput for our reservation.

Please advise asap on temporary fixes (burst authorization, routing to fallback model, throttles) and whether Redwood can provide credits if this extends beyond our SLA.

Thanks,
James Howell
VP, Platform Engineering
Clearwater Analytics
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: James Howell <j.howell@clearwater-analytics.com>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent — month-end job failures (500s) and surge in latency

James — thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. I'm escalating this to SRE and Exec immediately. Short plan while we triage:

1) We will provision an emergency burst onto your dedicated pool to buy headroom for the next 4 hours.
2) SRE will validate whether routing a percentage of traffic to the fallback (quantized) model reduces tail latency without materially changing outputs.
3) We'll open a short bridge (30m) to coordinate mitigations and confirm any credits if SLA impacted.

David is on the triage; Olga I need a quick utilization snapshot and estimate of how much burst capacity we should authorize. Marcus / Marissa, can we authorize a 4-hour emergency burst and provisional credit pending RCA?

Meeting: 8:40am PDT short bridge — I'm sending invite.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, James Howell <j.howell@clearwater-analytics.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent — month-end job failures (500s) and surge in latency

Quick triage notes from infra (summary):
- Root cause signal: sudden batch spike from Clearwater's scheduled reconciliation window increased concurrent token generation by ~3.8x starting 07:48 PDT.
- Effect: the dedicated GPU pool hit sustained 96% utilization on NV48s, KV cache contention increased, and request queues built up — p95/p99 latency climbed and a small percentage of requests started returning 503s/502s due to transient OOM/retry storms.
- Snapshot attached: reserved-usage-snapshot.csv (per-pool utilization, queue depth, token/s).

Immediate mitigations we can apply (fastest to implement):
- Authorize a temporary burst of 20k tokens/sec onto the dedicated pool for 4 hours (recommended).
- Roll 15% of Clearwater traffic to a compatible quantized variant (functionally equivalent for reconciliation workloads) to reduce GPU pressure.
- Enable short-term per-customer token-rate throttles with 1.5s backoff to prevent retry amplification.

We can do all three in parallel. Estimated incremental infra cost for the 4-hour burst: ~$1,800. If approved, ops can apply the burst in ~8 minutes and start the roll to quantized variant in ~20 minutes.

Technical ask for Clearwater: please confirm whether the reconciliation job can tolerate the quantized variant for tonight's run and share any strict model fidelity checks we should avoid.

-David
David Kim
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, James Howell <j.howell@clearwater-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent — month-end job failures (500s) and surge in latency

Marissa / Marcus — request for emergency authorization:

Summary: Clearwater (reserved capacity customer) is experiencing dedicated pool saturation during their month-end reconciliation, leading to elevated p95/p99 and a rising number of 5xx. SRE recommends a 4-hour emergency burst (20k tokens/sec) + 15% traffic roll to quantized fallback + short token-rate throttles. Incremental cost estimate: ~$1,800.

Customer ask: immediate burst to avoid missed SLAs tonight and confirmation of credits if their contract SLA is breached.

Proposed customer-facing message (short):
"Vanessa/Redwood has authorized an immediate, temporary burst and will roll a small percentage of traffic to a performance-equivalent variant to stabilize throughput. We're monitoring and will follow up with an RCA within 48 hours"

Decision requested: Approve emergency burst and provisional credit (50% of incremental infra cost or a capped credit of $2,000) while we complete RCA. If approved, I'll notify James and Ops will enact within 10 minutes.

—Vanessa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, James Howell <j.howell@clearwater-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent — month-end job failures (500s) and surge in latency

Approved.

- Authorize the 4-hour emergency burst and proceed with the 15% roll to the quantized variant. Ops: execute immediately and confirm when live.
- Approve a provisional customer credit capped at $2,000 for this incident; final credit will be confirmed after RCA.
- Require a post-incident RCA delivered to me and the customer within 48 hours and a costed mitigation plan (pre-warming, scheduling windows, and reservation buffer recommendations).

Vanessa — please send the customer-facing note and schedule the RCA meeting. David / Olga, please capture action items and timelines.

Thank you all — prioritize stability tonight.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Customer Success & Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
